purpose: Replicate the post-credential capability-legibility question in a different role layer: graduate technical hiring rather than frontline skilled-trade hiring.

named_actor.organization: 徐州徐工挖掘机械有限公司
public_recruitment_context: 2027 campus recruitment publicly lists welding process, machining process, test analysis, AI algorithm and data-analysis technical roles.
The public recruitment notice provides a named HR contact and public recruiting email.
These roles provide a distinct test from frontline welder/bending-trainee roles because academic credentials and interview performance are more prominent screening signals.

probe.subject: 调研请教：技术类校招中，哪些真实能力最难通过学历和面试判断
questions: Which technical roles most often produce candidates who interview well but still need substantial time before independent work?
How does the employer currently close that gap: internships, project evidence, written/practical tests, probation, mentoring or another mechanism?
Do current methods already solve the problem or is there still meaningful repeated verification, cultivation or mismatch cost?
Would a small, job-relevant and verifiable task proof before interview materially improve hiring judgment?

replication_logic.probe_002_role_layer: graduate technical engineering / data / AI / process roles
replication_logic.same_mechanism_tested: Does the receiving organization still lack trustworthy task-level visibility after conventional credentials/interview screening?
replication_logic.promotion_requires: Repeated direct actor evidence that existing practical/project/probation mechanisms leave material avoidable cost, not merely normal employer-specific onboarding.

next_action: Do not send additional capability-proof outreach until these two named employer probes yield response, bounce, rejection or a reasonable no-response interval. Continue only passive evidence scan in parallel.
